_note: Per-slug edits applied by scripts/offplan/build.py. `summary` is required for every project. `projectNumber` values come from the DLD Real Estate Projects open dataset (data.dubai 467654, file of 6 Jul 2026), matched on developer number and project name. `patch` overrides researched fields; `area` forces the area-guide match (null keeps a project out of the guides).
